systems.country_label: DataToCare, système intégré de gestion des informations de laboratoire (LIS)
systems.owner: Ministry of Public Health, Direction Nationale des Laboratoires et Imagerie médicale, with UNDP support and Global Fund C19RM financing
systems.tiers: nine pilot laboratory sites deployed 18-29 May 2026 (national reference laboratory at INSP, CHUK Kamenge, Hôpital Militaire de Kamenge, ANSS, Kinama health centre, Ngozi and Gitega regional hospitals, Muyinga hospital, Kigutu); 10 instruments connected, 64 planned nationwide

note: The only system described is a laboratory information system (single-function); no HMIS or EMR is named.
